data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for using the Cloud Functions for Firebase API.
data.what_it_does: Allows your Flutter application to call and interact with backend functions hosted on Firebase Cloud Functions. It supports platforms like Android, iOS, web, and macOS.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app using Firebase backend infrastructure.
You need to execute server-side logic from your mobile, web, or desktop app via Cloud Functions.
avoid_when: You are not using Firebase as your backend provider.
You prefer a non-Firebase backend solution like Supabase or Appwrite.
strengths: Official Firebase plugin with regular updates and community support.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, and macOS.
weaknesses: Tight coupling to the Firebase ecosystem.
Requires managing native configuration and SDK requirements (such as minSdk 24 on Android).
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Firebase in your project using firebase_core and configuring native platform SDKs (e.g., minimum SDK 24 on Android).

alternatives.name: supabase
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Supabase if you are using Supabase Edge Functions instead of Firebase Cloud Functions.

alternatives.name: supabase_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick Supabase Flutter for integrated backend functions and database with Supabase.
